purpose: Record the extended live lifecycle proof for candidate physical CD-RAM bank $87 before any English-runtime mutation.

operator_sequence: one or more NPC dialogue paths including menu/option handling
leave the bar and allow subsequent room/resource loads to complete
re-enter the bar and allow interior resources to reload

authenticated_bartender.note: The same H_BARTEN stream was observed before and after intervening load/transition activity.

menu_control_evidence.note: Exact opcode names remain to be established; these accesses show that the run exercised parser control flow beyond straight two-byte Shift-JIS text.

bank_87.scope_limit: This does not assert that bank $87 is globally free across every mission, scene, System Card service, or game mode.

remainder_sector_read.purpose: scratch read before copying the trailing non-sector-aligned bytes

loader_evidence.conclusion: The existing game loader accepts byte-oriented resource lengths and performs full-sector reads plus a final scratch-sector copy for non-2048-byte-aligned tails. This is suitable for deliberately relocated English resources once their descriptors/sectors are patched.

renderer_evidence.conclusion: A custom English glyph provider can target the existing 32-byte 16x16 buffer contract and return to the stock post-font path at 0x56C3.

decision.bank_87: promoted from unproven candidate to scoped controlled-experiment candidate for the first embedded-font loader/residency proof
decision.next_gate: Perform a controlled loader experiment that deliberately loads authenticated English/font test data into physical bank $87, restores MPR mappings, and reruns the same lifecycle before treating $87 as owned_for_english_runtime.
